name: claude-multiagent-code-review-starter
description: Starter project for building a multi-agent code review system using Claude Agent SDK
author: Udacity

scripts.test:live:cli: npm run build && RUN_LIVE_CLI_INTEGRATION=1 vitest run tests/integration/cli.live.test.ts --reporter=verbose
scripts.test:live:reports: npm run build && RUN_LIVE_REPORT_GENERATION=1 vitest run tests/integration/reports.live.test.ts --reporter=verbose
scripts.test:live:anthropic-credit: npm run build && RUN_LIVE_ANTHROPIC_CREDIT_CHECK=1 vitest run tests/integration/anthropic-credit.live.test.ts --reporter=verbose
scripts.test:ci: npm run build && npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
